summary: Adopts the 2026-2027 yearly update to the 2023-2028 housing and community development plan and lets the Mayor send it to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development. It covers use of CDBG, HOME, ESG and HOPWA funds for June 1, 2026 to May 31, 2027, with MDHA running the plan and Council approval still needed for CDBG capital improvement spending.
